page.title: 見た場面を、そのまま文にする

analysis.summaryJa: see/hear/feel等の知覚動詞では、O＋動詞原形で出来事全体を直接経験したこと、O＋-ingで進行中の一場面を捉えたことを表す。一方hear that＋文は現場の音ではなく情報として聞いた内容を報告する。
visualEvidence: 出来事全体のフィルムと進行中スナップの2レンズ
hear thatの情報スクロール
commonTraps: 知覚動詞後にto不定詞を置く
原形と-ingの視点差を無視する
hear＋O＋動詞とhear that節を混同する
Oを主節の主語と誤認する

questions.prompt: I saw the courier ------- the package at the reception desk and then leave.

choices.A: deliver
choices.B: to deliver
choices.C: delivered as finite verb

questions.translationJa: 私は配達員が受付で荷物を届け、その後立ち去る一連の出来事を見ました。
questions.explanationJa: 出来事全体を見届けたのでsee＋O＋動詞原形deliverです。

questions.prompt: We noticed several guests ------- in the lobby when the announcement began.

choices.A: wait as whole completed event
choices.B: waiting
choices.C: to waiting

questions.translationJa: 案内が始まったとき、数名の来客がロビーで待っているのに気づきました。
questions.explanationJa: その時進行中の場面を捉えたためwaitingです。

questions.prompt: The technician heard the alarm ------- once and immediately checked the panel.

choices.A: to beep
choices.B: beeping only necessarily ongoing
choices.C: beep

questions.translationJa: 技術者は警報が一度鳴るのを聞き、すぐ操作盤を確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: 一回の出来事をひとまとまりで聞いたため原形beepです。

questions.prompt: We heard ------- the afternoon flight had been canceled.

choices.A: the flight cancel directly at scene
choices.B: the flight canceling as information
choices.C: to the flight

questions.translationJa: 午後の便が欠航になったと聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: 現場の音ではなく情報内容を聞いたのでhear that＋文です。

questions.prompt: From the meeting room, I could hear the construction crew ------- outside for most of the morning.

choices.A: working
choices.B: work as necessarily whole event
choices.C: to work

questions.translationJa: 会議室から午前中の大半、工事スタッフが外で作業している音が聞こえました。
questions.explanationJa: 長く進行している一場面として知覚するのでworkingです。

questions.prompt: The supervisor watched the operator ------- the shutdown procedure from start to finish.

choices.A: to complete
choices.B: complete
choices.C: completed finite

questions.translationJa: 監督者は操作者が停止手順を最初から最後まで完了するのを見届けました。
questions.explanationJa: from start to finishが出来事全体を示すため原形completeです。

questions.prompt: As I entered the warehouse, I saw a forklift ------- toward the loading area.

choices.A: move as necessarily completed
choices.B: to move
choices.C: moving

questions.translationJa: 倉庫に入ったとき、フォークリフトが荷捌き場へ動いているのが見えました。
questions.explanationJa: 入った瞬間に進行中の場面を見たためmovingです。

questions.prompt: The receptionist heard ------- the client would arrive an hour late.

choices.A: the client arrive as direct sound
choices.B: the client arriving necessarily
choices.C: to client

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は顧客が1時間遅れて到着すると聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: 到着予定という情報を聞いたためthat節を使います。

questions.prompt: Because she observed the entire test, Ms. Ono saw the prototype ------- successfully and then shut down.

choices.A: start
choices.B: starting only
choices.C: to start

questions.translationJa: 試験全体を観察したため、小野さんは試作品が正常に起動し、その後停止するまで見ました。
questions.explanationJa: entire testと後続then shut downから出来事全体の原形startが適切です。

questions.prompt: In “I heard the manager speaking” versus “I heard that the manager spoke,” the first reports ------- while the second reports information.

choices.A: a directly perceived ongoing scene
choices.B: only a written report
choices.C: a destination

questions.translationJa: 前者は直接知覚した進行中の場面、後者は情報として聞いた内容です。
questions.explanationJa: O＋-ingとthat節の機能差を問う問題です。
questions.focus: 直接知覚と情報の対比

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for witnessing a complete event.

choices.A: I saw the train leave the station.
choices.B: I saw the train to leave the station.
choices.C: I saw the train left the station as finite.
choices.D: I saw to the train leave.

questions.translationJa: 私は列車が駅を出るのを見ました。
questions.explanationJa: 知覚動詞＋O＋原形で出来事全体を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for observing an action in progress.

choices.A: We noticed the staff to setting up the room.
choices.B: We noticed setting up the staff the room.
choices.C: We noticed the staff setted up the room.
choices.D: We noticed the staff setting up the room.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはスタッフが部屋を準備しているのに気づきました。
questions.explanationJa: 進行中の場面を-ingで説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting information rather than a directly heard sound.

choices.A: We heard the office close tomorrow.
choices.B: We heard that the office would close tomorrow.
choices.C: We heard the office closing tomorrow as report only.
choices.D: We heard to the office tomorrow.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは事務所が明日閉まると聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: 未来の予定情報をhear that節で報告しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that naturally emphasizes the whole event.

choices.A: I watched the technician repairing the unit from start to finish.
choices.B: I watched the technician to repair the unit.
choices.C: I watched the technician repair the unit from start to finish.

questions.translationJa: 私は技術者が装置を修理する一連の作業を最初から最後まで見ました。
questions.explanationJa: 全体を見届けた文脈なので原形repairが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that naturally captures a scene underway at one moment.

choices.A: When I passed the lobby, I saw guests waiting for taxis.
choices.B: When I passed the lobby, I saw guests to wait for taxis.
choices.C: When I passed the lobby, I saw guests waited for taxis.
choices.D: When I passed the lobby, I saw waiting guests are finite.

questions.translationJa: ロビーを通ったとき、来客がタクシーを待っているのが見えました。
questions.explanationJa: 通過時点で進行中の場面なのでwaitingです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct direct-perception sentence with “hear.”

choices.A: I heard that the door slam as direct structure.
choices.B: I heard to the door slam.
choices.C: I heard the door slammed finite.

questions.translationJa: 私はドアがバタンと閉まる音を聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: その場で一回の出来事を直接聞くhear＋O＋原形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that reports secondhand information.

choices.A: I heard the supplier raise prices as a report from email only.
choices.B: I heard that the supplier had raised its prices.
choices.C: I heard the supplier raising prices necessarily as secondhand.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先が価格を引き上げたと聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: 出来事を直接知覚したのではなく情報内容なのでthat節です。

questions.prompt: Choose the best sentence if you heard a machine making noise continuously while you were nearby.

choices.A: I heard the machine make a noise once.
choices.B: I heard that the machine made noise from a report.
choices.C: I heard the machine making a strange noise.
choices.D: I heard to the machine making noise.

questions.translationJa: 機械が変な音を出し続けているのが聞こえました。
questions.explanationJa: 継続中の音の場面にはmakingが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the best analysis of “We felt the floor shake.”

choices.A: floor is O and shake expresses the event directly perceived through feeling.
choices.B: shake is a direct object unrelated to floor.
choices.C: to shake is required after feel.

questions.translationJa: floorが目的語で、shakeが感覚で直接捉えた出来事を表します。
questions.explanationJa: feel＋O＋原形の知覚構造です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where changing -ing to a bare verb would most clearly shift the viewpoint from an ongoing scene to the event as a whole.

choices.A: We heard that the train was late.
choices.B: We saw the employee carrying the box downstairs.
choices.C: The employee carried the box.

questions.translationJa: carryingをcarryにすると進行中の一場面から運ぶ出来事全体へ視点が変わります。
questions.explanationJa: 知覚動詞後の-ingと原形の視点差です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I saw the bus leave.”

choices.A: I witnessed the bus's departure as a complete event.
choices.B: I only received information that it left.
choices.C: I necessarily saw it halfway through leaving.
choices.D: I told the bus to leave.

questions.translationJa: 私はバスが出発する出来事をひとまとまりとして見届けました。
questions.explanationJa: 原形leaveは出来事全体の知覚を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I saw the bus leaving.”

choices.A: I learned from someone that the bus left.
choices.B: I saw the bus while its departure was in progress.
choices.C: I watched the entire trip necessarily.
choices.D: I caused the bus to leave.

questions.translationJa: 私はバスが出発している途中の場面を見ました。
questions.explanationJa: -ingは進行中の一場面を切り取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We heard the lock click.”

choices.A: We read that the lock clicked.
choices.B: We discussed the lock.
choices.C: We directly heard the clicking event occur.
choices.D: We heard information about tomorrow's lock.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは鍵がカチッと鳴る出来事をその場で直接聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: hear＋O＋原形で直接知覚です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We heard that the lock was broken.”

choices.A: We directly heard a breaking sound necessarily.
choices.B: We watched the lock break.
choices.C: We caused the lock to break.
choices.D: We received information that the lock was broken.

questions.translationJa: 鍵が壊れているという情報を聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: that節は情報内容を報告します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The guard watched the visitor enter the room.”

choices.A: The guard observed the visitor's entry as an event.
choices.B: The guard only heard a report about the entry.
choices.C: visitor was already inside throughout the observation necessarily.

questions.translationJa: 警備員は来訪者が部屋へ入る出来事を見届けました。
questions.explanationJa: enter原形で出来事を一まとまりとして捉えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The guard watched the visitor entering the room.”

choices.A: The guard received a report.
choices.B: The guard observed the visitor while the entry was underway.
choices.C: The visitor never entered.
